rule: Every tracked image, video and audio file is listed here with a class. Game media (a capture, frame or clip of a game) is refused except the two README clips of Pedro's 2026-09-29 written exception, each 4,000,000 bytes or less: ADR 0002 decision 6, plans/ROADMAP.md gate table. tools/test-media.mjs holds it.

classes.game-clip: A gameplay recording. Only the two README clips of the written exception.
classes.diagram: A figure drawn by the project: a plot, chart, timeline or schematic. No game pixels.
classes.icon: An app, launcher or favicon image.
classes.ui-art: Artwork for the trainer or the Companion's own interface. No game pixels.
classes.font-preview: A rendering of a bundled font.

files.shows: The Companion's adaptive launcher icon foreground, 512 x 512: a stylised render of a character holding a cupcake on a dark background, resized by android/companion/make-icon.py from its source render. Not a screen capture; it does depict a FNaF 2 character (Toy Chica).
The same render at 192 x 192, the pre-API-26 legacy launcher icon, from android/companion/make-icon.py.
README clip: FNaF 1 4/20 on the phone with the teach panel overlaid (camera view, timer bars for Bonnie, Chica and Foxy).
README clip: FNaF 2 Night 7 cycle 22 on the phone with the teach panel overlaid (mask on, next action and countdown).
